matchups.tips: Has high burst damage and is hard to kill after level 6. Avoid being isolated, reduce his Q damage with a short W or stall some time with a longer W. His invisibility is the main counter here since you cannot damage him in that time which means your abilities might run out or he could escape and make you waste your time.

Can cancel your W or burst you while you're CC'ed, she also has untargetability which makes it hard to kill her. Avoid her if she has a red buff before level 6 since she can kite or chase you and either wait for her to miss her cocoon or dodge it with your Q. Qss can also help.
Has alot of Damage but also a almost unavoidable knockup, good mobility and untargetability on her R which makes it hard to duel her. Try Avoiding this champ if you can.

Just annoying. Dodge his stuff either with your Q or your high MMS. Can be hard to kill, go for easier targets. If he is in his Passive try to hit the parts ones let them get closer together and use your Q to hit all of them at ones, you can also use Smite, don't Q if there are alot of minions around cuz it'll delay your time u got to kill him.

It gets harder to deal with after she gets LvL 6 or fed so try to fight her before that to get her behind. Stick to your Teammates, control wards can be a big help. Getting Qss is also a good option to be able to negate her burst by using your W after cleansing her charm.

If you think you have enough damage, try to burst him before he can fear you without using your Q or use your Q before he starts his fear animation to get the most damage out of the situation. If you think you won't kill him before his fear hits you can use your Q as late as possible as he trys to fear you to reduce the CC duration afterwards. Qss can be a big help otherwise.

His Ult is predictable but his Bodyslam can set you in a bad spot if he brings friends. Also if he Builds Ap you gonna have a hard time since you can't really use the damage reduction of your W against his CC. You could bait him by using your W, to then dodge his slam tho.
Generally not really hard to beat, that is if it's a 1v1 situation. Once even just 1 more champ is with him, his taunt will be a big problem, untill you get Qss.
Can be difficult especially if Fed, use your W when he jumps out of his ult or stick to your Team.

Good luck! You can get Oracle at LvL 1 in this Matchup. Try to destroy his Boxes if he places them before you (try to use your doublestrike or smite if possible). You can also try to run away from him after he Ults in order to know which one is the real thing. You need some experience about his Movements and Playstyles, can be tricky to beat a good Shaco player but usually his clone takes alot more and noticeable damage, keep that in mind.
Avoid him or get Qss. Try to Dodge his E or R with your Q and stick to your team.

Who's faster? Hard to Catch and hard to escape from, he can kite you very easy with his stun and high movespeed. His early is also stronger, wait for enough items befor trying to 1v1 but it's also just better to only face him in teamfights.

If you play against another Yi player you should try to Q him before he does in order to have an advantage. If the other Yi player Q's first you should W his Q. Stopwatch and Guardians Angel can help you win a fight. Use Stopwatch as soon as he Q's you.
Ones you are 6 don't Ult till he has used his fear otherwise you will run very far away and your Ult might run out. Ones you have Qss he is a Childsplay.
If not Fed you beat him. Dodge his E or R with your Q.
His Smoke Screen is annoying and he has alot of damage but since he has no CC, you can dodge alot of his spells or negate his damage with your W.

If he misses the knockup you should win, also you can Dodge his Ult Dmg or Escape out of it, by Q'ing nearby minions or Champions. You have to Q after his dash animation starts, in order to not get hit by his knockup.
Annoying CC which buys her enough time for backup. Try to Dodge her ult with your Q.

Press W if he uses his Ult on you to safe your Ult and E Duration. Blue Kayn's Damage can be Meditated however if he is very ahead it could be hard to react you can also dodge his spells with your Q. Red Kayn can be harder to deal with the later the Game gets, try to avoid his knockup or fight him after he has used his ult.
Dodge his stun or follow his R with your Q, he can deal alot of damage but you scale better so later on you should be good. Also try to stop him from getting takedowns otherwise he will heal alot.
Avoid him before having some items and get Qss in the worst Case.
Dodge her Q with your high mobility, try to Burst her and Q before she hits her Ult. Care for backup she can set you up very easy.
You should avoid 1v1's since he can be hard to kill and has decent damage but later on you destroy him.
He has a Strong early so try fighting him with backup or with a few more items.
Besides the fact that he keeps Kicking you around he can be easy to beat. You can dodge his 2nd Q with yours and you out scale him.
You can dodge his Q and Ult.

Has alot of dashes which can be annoying but you should be able to keep up with her. She also needs to stay close if she plans on fighting you in where you should win since her only CC ability is very avoidable and DPS wise you win anyways since you're Yi.
Has a Strong early but there is nothing needed to dodge in his Kit which means ones you get some Items you destroy him.
You can dodge his Ult or reduce it's damage with your W. If he tries to run away you can cancel his big snowball by using your Q on him.
Can be strong and tanky but has no CC to stop you. But keep in mind that she can run at or away from you with her ms boost.
You beat her in most situations if she's not fed and has no hourglas. You can meditate her burst or simply dodge her ult with your Q.
Can kite you in the worst case but is nothing threatening.
Avoid her Spears. If you don't get Kited you beat her pretty easy. If she gets ahead or finishes hourglas you have to be more careful.
Safe your Q if she has her Ult and use it after its over. You should win most of the time in any situation.
Very easy to beat all game long but be careful of his counter jungle. Dodge his Q or Ult knockup with your Q, you can still use ur W in his Q.

He can't slow you in your R, you can dodge his Ult with your Q, on top of that he has no mobility, is squishy and has no hard CC, you can also negate all of the damage from his abilities with your W so he is one of the easiest matchups for yi.
